A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and contain complete Appendices A–H. Extracted text and rendered pages support reliable comparison, including graphical results. V3 removes the NeurIPS checklist and compresses the bibliography without removing scientific appendices.

before.justification: Section 6 and Appendix H report original maze-navigation experiments, including spectral approximation, goal-reaching accuracy and sample-efficiency results.

after.justification: Section 6 and Appendix H retain original maze-navigation experiments and report revised empirical curves.

M1.justification: Section 6 corrects the reported TD bootstrap from the shifted future pair (s_{t+k+1}, a_{t+k+1}) to the immediate next pair (s_{t+1}, a_{t+1}). This changes the stated learning rule. The shifted-successor definition and main truncated-SVD estimator remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same four-room, Medium-maze, U-maze and Large-maze environments, including the non-uniform collection-policy scenario. Appendix H.5 remains a discussion of possible non-tabular extensions rather than an additional evaluation.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is retained: the same shift variants, oracle and TD estimates, standard versus measure-weighted SVD, and TD versus model-based estimation appear in the corresponding comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 6 revises the specified training samples to include the immediate next state-action pair alongside the current and shifted pairs, matching the corrected TD update. Reported trajectory lengths, rank choices, evaluation metrics and data-collection policies remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Replacement curves revise the existing sensitivity evidence concerning rank, shift and sample size in Figures 4, 7 and 8, and the estimator comparison across shifts in Figure 11. The analysis questions remain unchanged; the four-room and non-uniform-policy analyses are retained.

E5.justification: V2's checklist explicitly identifies shaded bands as standard deviations; v3 removes that explanation without replacing it elsewhere. Figures retain shading and the stated averages over five seeds and 100 goals. No increase in run counts is reported.

E6.justification: TD results in Figures 4, 7 and 8, panels e–h, are substantially revised, as are both estimator curves in Figure 11. For example, Figure 11's TD result for k=17 at 10,000 trajectories changes from approximately 0.1 to 0.4 accuracy. These are replacement results accompanying an empirical correction, rather than a controlled performance gain under an unchanged TD procedure. Spectral and oracle results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The spectral-recoverability definitions, sample-complexity bounds, Type II Poincaré inequalities and proofs in Appendices A–G are retained. Indicator-symbol typography changes do not alter the mathematics; the TD correction concerns the empirical learning rule.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about low-rank structure emerging after shifting, finite-sample estimation guarantees, local mixing and benefits for goal-conditioned reinforcement learning.

C2.justification: The interpretations of shifting, estimation difficulty and TD versus model-based scalability remain unchanged, as do the limitations in Section 7 and Appendices C/H. Appendix H.4 corrects a sampled-state tuple without introducing a new mechanism explanation or applicability boundary.

D1.justification: Checklist removal drops statements that supplementary material contains the full code, configuration files and scripts. The existing code link and Appendix H's single-CPU, within-a-day resource description remain. This is reduced documentation, not evidence that code access was withdrawn.

R1.justification: Reference 4 replaces Azar, Munos and Kappen's 2013 PAC sample-complexity paper with Azar, Osband and Munos's 2017 regret-bounds paper, while the citing passage in Appendix C.1 remains unchanged. Other reference changes primarily concern formatting, renumbering and publication metadata; the research-positioning narrative is retained.

P1.justification: V3 removes the checklist, adds an acknowledgment of the corrected empirical error, and makes localized TD-description and bibliography edits. The main narrative, section sequence and appendix organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Bibliography entries are shortened and reflowed, the checklist block disappears, and indicator glyphs are restyled. The eleven figures retain their panel structures, axes, legends and captions; their changed empirical values are assessed under E6.

improvement.justification: V3 corrects the reported TD bootstrap and replaces affected experimental curves, addressing an empirical error explicitly acknowledged by the authors. This improves the reliability of the empirical section while preserving the theoretical contribution. Removing the standard-deviation explanation and supplementary-code details creates a limited reporting loss, but the correction supports a modest net improvement.
